title: Competitive performance of a modularized deep neural network compared to commercial algorithms for low-dose CT image reconstruction

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】Deep learning has been investigated for low-dose CT (LDCT).

evidence.text: Deep learning has been investigated for low-dose CT (LDCT).

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Competitive performance of a modularized deep neural network compared to commercial algorithms for low-dose CT image reconstruction》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】While popular networks are trained for an end-to-end mapping, our network performs an end-to-process mapping so that intermediate denoised images are obtained with associated noise reduction directions towards a final denoised image.

【Abstract · abstract-1-6】Our network was trained with the Mayo LDCT Dataset, and tested on separate chest and abdominal CT exams from Massachusetts General Hospital.

evidence.text: While popular networks are trained for an end-to-end mapping, our network performs an end-to-process mapping so that intermediate denoised images are obtained with associated noise reduction directions towards a final denoised image.
Our network was trained with the Mayo LDCT Dataset, and tested on separate chest and abdominal CT exams from Massachusetts General Hospital.
